decisions.reason: The position delivers an additional copy of the product documentation on CD, not a separately procured product.
The ordered units are sets of product documentation; the binders are only the delivery format.
The position covers fabrication and installation planning, drawings, and schedules, with no new physical product supplied.
The position covers pipeline surveying, georeferencing, and documentation, not the supply of new pipe or equipment.
The position pays for hourly labor and associated costs, not for a physical product.
